marketing-communications.subtitle: Marketing campaigns, communications strategy, brand messaging, and promotional content

groups.usecase: Perform audience research and develop personas

prompts.name: Conduct in-depth audience research
prompts.body: I am a marketing specialist at [company name] focused on [specific area/vertical] developing targeted campaigns for [specific personas]. Create a comprehensive audience research profile for [target audience] including: detailed demographics (age, income, location, education, job titles), psychographic insights (values, motivations, lifestyle, decision-making factors), digital behavior and preferred platforms (social media, content consumption, communication channels), key pain points and challenges that [product] addresses, messaging framework with language preferences and communication style, content formats and topics that engage them, and competitive analysis of how similar audiences are currently being targeted. Format as an actionable persona guide for campaign development.

groups.usecase: Improve collaboration with customers, agencies, and teams

prompts.name: Generate a project tracker from meeting notes
prompts.body: I am a [project manager/marketing coordinator/team lead] creating a project tracker from our recent meeting. Using @[Meeting Notes from Gemini], extract all action items and create a comprehensive project tracker with columns for: Task/Action Item, Assigned Owner, Priority Level (High/Medium/Low), Due Date, Status (Not Started/In Progress/Complete), Dependencies, and Notes/Context. Include any deadlines, deliverables, or follow-up items mentioned in the meeting. Format as a trackable spreadsheet that can be updated regularly and shared with the team for accountability and progress monitoring.

prompts.name: Suggest blog post topics for a specific industry
prompts.body: I am a [content marketing manager/travel blogger/tourism industry professional] developing unique blog content for travel and tourism audiences. Generate 8-10 distinctive blog post topics with fresh angles that differentiate from typical travel content, incorporating current industry trends, challenges, or innovations. For each topic provide: specific target audience (travel professionals, adventure seekers, sustainable travelers, etc.), 3-4 bullet point content outline covering main discussion points, and engaging call-to-action suggestion to drive reader interaction. Focus on timely, relevant angles that offer unique perspectives on travel industry developments, emerging destinations, or innovative travel solutions.

prompts.name: Create an image for a marketing campaign
prompts.body: I am a [marketing manager/creative director/travel company owner] creating visual content for our travel marketing campaign. Design a stunning promotional image featuring an airplane flying above clouds over mountainous landscape with winding rivers during golden hour sunrise. The image should evoke wanderlust and adventure, include dramatic lighting and vibrant sunrise colors, showcase breathtaking natural scenery that inspires travel, maintain high resolution suitable for various marketing materials (social media, website, print), and align with travel industry aesthetics that communicate exploration and freedom. Style should be cinematic and aspirational to drive engagement with potential travelers.

prompts.name: Create compelling copy for a landing page
prompts.body: I am a [copywriter/marketing manager/digital marketer] creating a high-converting landing page for a [specific ebook/webinar/free trial] targeting C-suite executives and senior leaders. Write compelling copy including: attention-grabbing headline that addresses executive pain points, value proposition highlighting key benefits and outcomes, bullet points showcasing specific insights or solutions, social proof elements (testimonials, company logos, statistics), urgency or scarcity elements to drive immediate action, persuasive call-to-action buttons with action-oriented language, and brief form copy that minimizes friction. Use executive-appropriate language that demonstrates expertise while emphasizing ROI and strategic value.

prompts.name: Generate copy for a lead nurture email sequence
prompts.body: I am a [marketing automation specialist/email marketing manager/lead nurture strategist] creating a 5-email automated sequence for leads who downloaded our ebook on [specific topic]. Generate personalized email copy with: strategic timing intervals (immediate, day 3, day 7, day 14, day 21), progressive value delivery building on the ebook content, subject lines and preview text for each email, calls-to-action leading to [specific valuable resources/offers], personalization elements using lead data and behavior, content that addresses common questions or next steps, and conversion-focused messaging that moves leads through the sales funnel. Maintain consistent brand voice while increasing engagement and trust.

prompts.name: Write email subject lines for a new product
prompts.body: I am a [marketing manager/email marketing specialist/product marketer] creating email subject lines for our [specific product] launch targeting [specific audience segments]. Write 3 professional yet catchy subject lines (30-50 characters each) that: directly reference the audience segments to increase relevance, highlight key product benefits or value propositions, use action-oriented language or curiosity gaps, maintain our brand voice and professional standards, and optimize for email open rates. Test different approaches like urgency, benefit-focused, and question-based formats

prompts.name: Write an email to a copywriting team for feedback
prompts.body: I am a [marketing manager/campaign manager/email marketing specialist] requesting feedback from our copywriting team on proposed email subject lines. Write a brief, professional email (75-100 words) that presents [suggested email subject lines] for their review, provides context about the campaign or target audience, requests constructive feedback and suggestions by end of week, expresses appreciation for their expertise and collaboration, and includes clear next steps for incorporating their input. Use a collaborative, respectful tone that values their professional input

prompts.name: Define a brand architecture
prompts.body: I am a brand manager at [company name] developing a comprehensive brand architecture for our diverse portfolio. Create a structured brand framework that organizes our portfolio: [list all existing brands, products, and services] aligned with our mission and vision: [company mission and vision], target audiences: [specific target audience descriptions], and desired positioning: [market positioning statement]. Include: master brand hierarchy (corporate, sub-brands, product lines), brand relationship strategy (endorsed, freestanding, or hybrid), naming conventions and visual identity guidelines, brand portfolio rationalization recommendations, and implementation roadmap. Ensure the architecture supports both current offerings and future growth while maintaining brand clarity and market differentiation.

prompts.name: Generate ideas for a creative and eye-catching logo
prompts.body: I am a [business owner/entrepreneur] developing branding for a coffee shop and video game cafe hybrid. Generate logo concepts that balance both coffee and gaming elements without clutter, appealing to gamers (casual to enthusiast) and coffee enthusiasts seeking a unique social space. Create 3-4 concepts in each style: Modern and Playful (bold colors, pixel art elements, fun graphics), Retro-Cool (arcade-inspired chunky lettering, neon color palette), and Sleek and Minimalist (clean geometric shapes, subtle dual-theme references). For each concept, describe: visual elements and color scheme, how it represents both business aspects, target audience appeal, and scalability across applications (signage, merchandise, digital use).

prompts.name: Generate more logo options in a specific style
prompts.body: I am a [business owner/brand designer] developing additional logo concepts for my coffee shop and video game cafe. Create 3 more retro-cool style logo options that expand on the arcade-inspired aesthetic, featuring: chunky, bold lettering reminiscent of classic arcade games, neon-inspired color palettes (electric blues, hot pinks, bright greens), vintage gaming elements (joysticks, power buttons, retro controllers) integrated with coffee imagery (beans, cups, steam), and authentic 80s/90s arcade aesthetic. Each concept should clearly represent both the coffee and gaming aspects while maintaining the nostalgic, high-energy vibe that appeals to gamers and coffee lovers.

prompts.name: Conduct a competitive analysis for a new brick-and-mortar store
prompts.body: I am an online business owner evaluating expansion into brick-and-mortar retail in [specific location/market]. Conduct a competitive analysis of [key competitors] focusing on [specific focus area – customer experience/pricing/location strategy]. For each competitor, analyze: store format and layout strategies, pricing and promotional tactics, customer service approach and in-store experience, location selection and foot traffic patterns, strengths and competitive advantages, notable weaknesses or gaps, and measurable results or market performance. Provide actionable recommendations for [my company] to differentiate and succeed in the physical retail space, including specific tactics to leverage our online expertise.

prompts.name: Generate a competitive analysis of two companies
prompts.body: I am a [business analyst/marketing manager/strategic planner] conducting a competitive analysis comparing [company name] versus [competitor name] in the [specific industry/market segment]. Analyze both companies across key dimensions: market positioning and brand differentiation, product/service offerings and pricing strategies, target audience and customer segments, marketing and distribution channels, financial performance and market share, operational strengths and weaknesses, recent strategic moves or innovations, and competitive advantages or vulnerabilities. Present findings in a structured comparison format with actionable insights for strategic decision-making and market positioning

groups.usecase: Deliver personalized content to customers at scale

prompts.name: Create a 5-step nurture email cadence
prompts.body: I am a [email marketing manager/marketing automation specialist/customer success manager] creating a nurture email sequence for newsletter subscribers to drive [product] purchases. Using @[Product Specific Notes] and @[Product FAQ], design a 5-email cadence including: email timing and sequence (days 1, 3, 7, 14, 21), subject lines and key messaging for each email, content progression from education to conversion, specific product benefits and features to highlight per email, clear calls-to-action leading to purchase, and personalization strategies. Focus on building trust and demonstrating value while addressing common objections or questions from the FAQ

prompts.name: Create inspirational images for a marketing campaign
prompts.body: I am a [creative director/marketing manager/brand designer] developing inspirational visuals for a marketing campaign promoting [specific product type/category]. Create photorealistic images incorporating [specific colors] color palette and [natural elements like clouds/mountains/water] that evoke inspiration and connection to [product benefits/brand values]. Each image should include: compelling composition with natural lighting, space for overlay text or logo placement, emotional resonance that aligns with campaign messaging, and professional quality suitable for [intended use – social media/print/digital ads]. Style should feel authentic, uplifting, and on-brand for our target audience.

prompts.name: Create an image of a trade show booth
prompts.body: I am a [marketing manager/trade show coordinator/event planner] designing a trade show booth concept for [company name/industry]. Create a visual design for a modern trade show booth featuring orange and blue color scheme with interactive computer stations for attendee engagement. Include: contemporary booth layout with clear branding areas, multiple interactive computer stations/kiosks positioned for easy access, professional lighting and display elements, space for product demonstrations or meetings, and welcoming entrance design. Style should be sleek, technology-forward, and optimized for visitor flow and engagement.

prompts.name: Write engaging social media posts
prompts.body: I am a [social media manager/marketing coordinator/content creator] developing posts for [specific platform – Instagram/LinkedIn/Twitter] about [product/service/topic] targeting [specific target audience demographics/interests]. Create 3 engaging posts (2 sentences each) that use different approaches: one educational/informative, one emotional/inspirational, and one urgency/promotional. Each post should include a clear call-to-action directing followers to visit [website name/URL] and incorporate relevant hashtags and platform-specific best practices for maximum engagement.

prompts.name: Create a social media post promoting an event
prompts.body: I am a [marketing manager/event coordinator/social media specialist] promoting [event name] on [specific platform – Instagram/LinkedIn/Facebook] targeting [specific audience demographics/interests]. Create an engaging post (platform-appropriate length) with attention-grabbing language that includes: compelling hook or opening line, key event details (date, time, location/format), main value proposition or benefits for attendees, clear call-to-action for registration/tickets, and 5-8 relevant hashtags mixing event-specific, audience-targeted, and trending tags. Use an energetic, persuasive tone that creates excitement and urgency

prompts.name: Create a comparison table between two proposals
prompts.body: I am a business owner evaluating cleaning service vendors using @[Company A Proposal] and @[Company B Proposal]. Create a detailed comparison table analyzing both proposals based on my requirements: twice-weekly service including vacuuming, mopping, dusting, window cleaning, and surface wiping. Compare: pricing structure (per visit, monthly rates, additional fees), service scope and what’s included/excluded, scheduling flexibility and availability, booking and cancellation policies, insurance and bonding coverage, experience and references, and contract terms. Format as a clear side-by-side comparison with a recommendation based on value and service alignment.

prompts.name: Write an email to a vendor to schedule a meeting
prompts.body: I am a business owner following up with Company A after receiving their cleaning service proposal. Write a professional email (75-100 words) that thanks them for their time and detailed proposal, expresses interest in moving forward, requests a meeting to discuss scheduling and logistics for twice-weekly cleaning services, and asks for their availability over the next week with 2-3 specific time slots. Use a courteous, business-appropriate tone that shows appreciation while demonstrating readiness to proceed with next steps.

groups.usecase: Create and optimize copy for search engine marketing (SEM)

prompts.name: Generate a list of keywords for an SEM campaign
prompts.body: I am a digital marketing manager at [company name] creating an SEM campaign for [specific product/service]. Using my seed keywords: [list keywords], generate an expanded keyword list including: 15-20 additional relevant keywords, 10-15 long-tail keyword phrases (3+ words), competitor brand keywords, question-based keywords (how, what, where), buying intent keywords (buy, purchase, price), and negative keyword suggestions to avoid irrelevant traffic. Organize by match type recommendations (broad, phrase, exact) and include estimated search volume ranges and competition levels where possible

prompts.name: Refine ad copy for a specific audience
prompts.body: I am a [digital marketing manager/copywriter/advertising specialist] refining ad copy for a [specific campaign type] targeting [specific audience demographics/psychographics]. Create 6-8 new ad copy variations with a [specific tone] that prominently feature [specific product feature/benefit]. Each variation should include: compelling headlines (platform character limits), persuasive descriptions emphasizing the key feature, audience-appropriate calls-to-action, and messaging that resonates with [audience]’s pain points and motivations. Ensure copy speaks directly to this audience’s language and priorities while maintaining consistent brand voice.

prompts.name: Generate ad copy variations for an SEM campaign
prompts.body: I am a [digital marketing manager/SEM specialist/paid search coordinator] creating ad copy variations for a search engine marketing campaign promoting [specific product/service]. Using the provided keywords as inspiration, generate 6-8 ad copy variations with different approaches: headlines (25-30 characters), descriptions (80-90 characters), and calls-to-action. Use a [specific tone] throughout and ensure each variation tests different value propositions (price, quality, convenience, urgency). Format for Google Ads specifications and include keyword integration suggestions for each variation.

groups.usecase: Create and manage content and distribution

prompts.name: Create a blog draft announcing a new hire
prompts.body: I am a [marketing manager/communications director/HR leader] at [company name] writing a blog post to announce our new hire. Create a professional blog draft (200-300 words) introducing [name] as our new [position] that includes: compelling opening paragraph about their appointment, 2-3 key background highlights [previous position/company, professional achievements, relevant experience], how their expertise aligns with our company goals and growth, what they’ll be focusing on in their new role, and a welcoming closing statement. Use an enthusiastic yet professional tone that reflects our company culture.

prompts.name: Create a project tracker for content amplification
prompts.body: I am a [content marketing manager/digital marketing coordinator] creating a project tracker for content amplification campaigns. Design a spreadsheet template with columns for: Content Title, Channel (social media, email, blog, etc.), Owner/Responsible Team Member, Content URL, Priority Level (High/Medium/Low), Publication Date, Status (Draft/Scheduled/Published/Complete), Engagement Metrics, and Notes. Include data validation for priority and status fields, conditional formatting to highlight high-priority items, and sample data rows showing different content types and channels for reference.

prompts.name: Develop a marketing plan for a new app
prompts.body: I am a [marketing manager/product manager/startup founder] developing a go-to-market plan for a new app that provides [specific functionality] targeting [detailed audience demographics/psychographics]. Create a comprehensive marketing plan covering: competitive landscape analysis with 3-5 key competitors, optimal marketing channel mix emphasizing [specific marketing channels] with rationale for each, budget allocation recommendations across channels, core messaging framework and value propositions, 90-day campaign timeline with key milestones, and measurable KPIs for each channel and overall success. Include expected user acquisition costs and conversion metrics for realistic planning.

prompts.name: Draft an email to a CMO about a strategic marketing plan
prompts.body: I am a [marketing manager/strategist/project lead] writing to our CMO about deliverables for the new app launch project. Draft a professional email (100-150 words) confirming I will deliver a strategic marketing one-pager by [specific date] that includes: executive summary with key recommendations, competitive landscape analysis for South American markets, prioritized marketing channel strategy with rationale, detailed target demographic profiles by region, and initial budget and timeline considerations. Use a confident, executive-appropriate tone that demonstrates strategic thinking and shows accountability for the deadline.

groups.usecase: Conduct market research and identify trends

prompts.name: Conduct market research to identify new trends
prompts.body: I am a [marketing manager/researcher/analyst] conducting market research on the [specific industry] to identify emerging trends and consumer shifts. Analyze the provided [URLs] and additional relevant sources to uncover: 3-5 key emerging trends with supporting data, shifting consumer preferences and behaviors, market disruptions or innovations, competitive landscape changes, and growth opportunities or threats. Present findings in a structured report format with trend analysis, consumer insights, and strategic implications for our business positioning in this market.

prompts.name: Generate variations of ad copy for A/B testing
prompts.body: I am a [marketing manager/copywriter/digital marketer] preparing A/B tests for our campaign. Using our current messaging: [messaging], generate 3 distinct ad copy variations that test different approaches: one focused on emotional appeal, one emphasizing rational benefits/features, and one using urgency or scarcity. Each variation should be [specific length – 25 words/2 sentences/character limit] and maintain our brand voice while exploring different persuasion angles. Include suggested headlines and calls-to-action for each version.

prompts.name: Identify potential influencers and complementary brands for a campaign
prompts.body: I am a [role] at [company name/industry] launching a campaign focused on [specific topic/theme]. Identify 3-4 influencer categories (micro, macro, celebrity, expert) with follower ranges and engagement rates, plus 5-7 complementary brand types for potential partnerships. For each category, specify: target audience alignment with [specific demographics/psychographics], content collaboration ideas (co-created posts, takeovers, joint events), partnership structures (paid, gifted, revenue-share), and expected reach/engagement metrics. Focus on authentic partnerships that enhance brand credibility and drive meaningful engagement rather than just follower counts

prompts.name: Brainstorm marketing materials for an event/sale
prompts.body: I own a [business type] in [location] promoting a [event/sale type] for [services/products]. Create marketing materials with a [tone] voice targeting both lapsed customers and new prospects: 3 social media posts for [platform] with relevant hashtags, one newsletter section (150 words), and two email drafts – one reactivation email for past customers (200 words) and one acquisition email for prospects (200 words). Include clear calls-to-action, emphasize [unique selling point], and create urgency around the [specific offer/timeframe].

prompts.name: Brainstorm tactics to bring in new customers
prompts.body: I operate a [business type] in [location] and want to attract new customers through [event/campaign type] without using discounts. Generate 8-10 alternative customer acquisition tactics across these categories: value-added incentives, experiential offerings, referral programs, community partnerships, and exclusive access opportunities. For each tactic, include a brief implementation example for my business type and indicate if it’s low/medium/high cost. Focus on strategies that build long-term customer relationships rather than one-time purchases

groups.usecase: Analyze social media trends and other data to reduce time to market

prompts.name: Research social media trends
prompts.body: I am a [role/title] at [company name/industry type] developing a [campaign type/strategy] for our [specific product category/service]. Research current social media trends across [platform names – Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, etc.] related to [specific topic/niche/hashtag]. Provide a comprehensive analysis including: trending hashtags and keywords with engagement metrics, top 5-10 influencers in this space with follower counts and engagement rates, content formats performing best (video, carousel, stories, etc.), common themes and messaging approaches in viral content, posting frequency and optimal timing data, and emerging sub-trends or niches within the topic. Present findings in a structured format with actionable insights for content strategy, include data sources and collection timeframe, and highlight opportunities for our brand to authentically participate in these conversations.

prompts.name: Analyse the findings in this report
prompts.body: Analyze the attached [report type – market research/customer survey/competitive analysis] focusing on insights relevant to [specific product/service] targeting [detailed target audience demographics/psychographics]. Identify and synthesize key themes, patterns, and data points related to [specific topic areas – customer pain points/market gaps/competitor strategies]. Provide a structured analysis including: top 3-5 recurring themes with supporting evidence from the report, quantitative insights and trends with specific metrics, qualitative patterns in customer feedback or market behavior, competitive positioning opportunities based on gaps identified, and actionable recommendations for messaging strategy. Present findings in priority order with clear rationale for how each insight directly impacts our [marketing campaign/product positioning/go-to-market strategy] for [target audience]. Include relevant quotes or data points from the report to support recommendations, and highlight any surprising or counterintuitive findings that challenge current assumptions.

productivity-automation.title: Productivity & Automation
productivity-automation.subtitle: Process automation, productivity optimization, and efficiency improvements

prompts.name: Create a detailed project plan for a new software development project
prompts.body: I am a [project manager/development lead/technical director] creating a detailed project plan for [project name], a software development initiative. Develop a comprehensive project plan including: project scope and deliverables aligned with goals [list of project goals], detailed timeline with milestones over [project timeline], team roles and responsibilities for [list of team members], budget allocation breakdown within [project budget], risk assessment and mitigation strategies, communication plan and meeting schedules, quality assurance and testing phases, and success metrics. Format as an actionable project management document with Gantt chart suggestions and dependency mapping

project-management.title: Project Management
project-management.subtitle: Project planning, execution, tracking, and team coordination

prompts.name: Summarize a call transcript and highlight action items
prompts.body: I am a [project manager/meeting coordinator/team lead] creating a concise call summary for team follow-up. Using the attached call transcript, write a brief paragraph summarizing the main discussion topics and overall meeting outcomes, then create organized bullet point lists for: action items with specific tasks and deadlines, decisions made during the call with context, assigned owners/responsible parties for each item, any unresolved issues or parking lot items, and next meeting dates or follow-up timeline. Format for easy reference and accountability tracking, ensuring all team members have clear visibility into their responsibilities and project progress

prompts.name: Draft a project status update email template
prompts.body: I am a [project manager/team lead/individual contributor] creating a weekly status update template for my manager on [project name/work area]. Draft a professional email template (200-250 words) with structured sections for: executive summary of overall project health and progress, key accomplishments and milestones achieved this week with quantifiable results, challenges or roadblocks encountered with proposed solutions or escalation needs, top 3 priorities for the upcoming week with expected outcomes, resource needs or support required from management, and timeline updates or risk mitigation items. Use a clear, concise format that enables quick scanning while providing sufficient detail for informed decision-making.

prompts.name: Write a meeting recap from brainstorm notes
prompts.body: I am a [project manager/team lead/meeting facilitator] following up with my team after our brainstorming session. Using @[Brainstorm Notes and Ideas 9/1/24], write an upbeat meeting recap email (200-250 words) that: thanks the team for their creative participation and energy, summarizes the key ideas and insights generated during the session, highlights particularly innovative or promising concepts, captures any decisions made or next steps identified, previews topics for our upcoming meeting focused on [specific topic], maintains momentum and excitement about our collaborative work, and encourages continued idea sharing. Use an enthusiastic, team-building tone that celebrates our collective creativity

prompts.name: Create a table of user acceptance tests
prompts.body: I am a [QA manager/project manager/business analyst] creating user acceptance tests for our website registration form functionality. Design a comprehensive UAT table with 10 test cases covering: successful registration scenarios, form validation testing (required fields, email format, password requirements), error handling and messaging, user experience flows, security considerations, and edge cases. Include columns for: Test Case ID, Test Description, Pre-conditions, Test Steps, Expected Results, Pass/Fail Status, and Notes. Ensure tests cover both positive and negative scenarios that validate the registration form meets business requirements and user expectations

prompts.name: Draft an email to a colleague about a UAT
prompts.body: I am a [project manager/QA lead/business analyst] coordinating with [colleague name] who is leading the user acceptance testing phase. Draft a clear, actionable email (100-150 words) that outlines their next steps for the UAT process including: specific UAT tasks or test cases to execute, timeline and deadlines for completion, required resources or access permissions needed, stakeholders to involve or communicate with, deliverables or documentation to produce, escalation process for any issues discovered, and offer of support or assistance. Use a collaborative, professional tone that provides clear direction while acknowledging their expertise in managing the testing process

groups.usecase: Develop an issue tracker and related communications

prompts.name: Create a spreadsheet to track project issues
prompts.body: I am a [project manager/team lead/operations coordinator] creating an issue tracking system for [project name/type]. Design a comprehensive spreadsheet template with columns for: Issue ID, Description/Summary, Category/Type, Priority Level (Critical/High/Medium/Low), Status (Open/In Progress/Resolved/Closed), Assigned Owner, Date Reported, Target Resolution Date, Action Items/Next Steps, and Resolution Notes. Include data validation for priority and status fields, conditional formatting to highlight overdue or critical issues, and filter/sort capabilities for easy project management. Format as a professional template suitable for team collaboration.

prompts.name: Draft an email template to escalate a critical project issue
prompts.body: I am a [project manager/team lead/program director] escalating a critical project issue to [stakeholder type – executive/sponsor/client]. Draft a professional escalation email (150-200 words) that includes: clear subject line indicating urgency and project name, concise problem statement with specific impact on timeline/budget/deliverables, root cause analysis or contributing factors, proposed solution with resource requirements and timeline, alternative options if applicable, immediate action needed from stakeholder, and next steps with follow-up timeline. Use a direct, solution-focused tone that conveys urgency while maintaining professional confidence.

prompts.name: Create a workback schedule for a software release
prompts.body: I am a technical project manager at [company] overseeing [project name and brief description] with delivery date of [delivery date]. Create a detailed workback schedule based on scope: [scope], goals: [project goals], deliverables: [project deliverables], and budget: [budget]. Include: major project phases with start/end dates, key milestones and deliverables, demo and review checkpoints, testing and QA phases, buffer time for risk mitigation, resource allocation across timeline, and critical path dependencies. Format as a timeline with weekly breakdown and highlight potential bottlenecks or high-risk phases.

prompts.name: Write a report detailing the successes, failures, and lessons learned from a project
prompts.body: I am a [project manager/team lead/operations director] conducting a post-project review for [project name]. Create 20 investigative questions for cross-team interviews covering: project successes and what enabled them, failures and root cause analysis, process breakdowns at specific stages, technical challenges and solutions, communication effectiveness and gaps, resource allocation and timeline management, stakeholder engagement and feedback, team collaboration dynamics, and actionable lessons learned. Structure questions to encourage honest, detailed responses and include both retrospective analysis and forward-looking improvement suggestions. Format for use in team interviews or surveys.

prompts.name: Summarize a project retrospective document
prompts.body: I am a [project manager/team lead/stakeholder] reviewing a project retrospective document. Summarize the attached document in two focused paragraphs: the first covering project overview (goals, scope, timeline, key contributors and their roles), and the second addressing outcomes and performance (deliverables achieved, measurable results, major successes, significant failures or challenges, and critical lessons learned). Focus on executive-level insights and actionable takeaways suitable for stakeholder briefings or future project planning reference

prompts.name: Summarize an email thread and list action items
prompts.body: You are a project coordinator and executive assistant. Analyze the provided email thread and create a clear, actionable summary for follow-up and tracking. Identify all action items, determine deadlines from context, and assess priority levels. Create a conversation overview and action items table with Action Item, Assigned Person, Due Date, Priority Level, Dependencies, and Status. Look for explicit commitments, implied responsibilities, and unclear accountability. Format with headings: ‘Thread Summary & Participants,’ ‘Action Items Table,’ ‘Confirmed Decisions,’ ‘Unresolved Issues,’ and ‘Risk Assessment & Next Steps’ to transform email discussions into clear accountability

recruitment.title: Recruitment
recruitment.subtitle: Talent acquisition, hiring processes, and recruitment operations

prompts.name: Create a list of strategies to improve the recruiting process
prompts.body: I am an [HR director/recruiting manager/talent acquisition lead] looking to optimize our recruitment strategy and candidate sourcing. Create a comprehensive list of 15-20 improvement strategies covering: sourcing channels and candidate pipeline development, application and screening process enhancements, interview efficiency and candidate experience improvements, employer branding and recruitment marketing tactics, technology and automation opportunities, diversity and inclusion initiatives, talent relationship building and networking approaches, metrics and KPI tracking for process optimization, and cost-effective recruiting methods. Include implementation difficulty levels and expected impact for prioritization, plus specific tactics for each strategy

prompts.name: Write a compelling role description for a content marketing manager
prompts.body: I am an [HR manager/recruiting manager/marketing director] creating a job posting for a content marketing manager position. Write a compelling role description (300-400 words) that attracts top talent including: engaging company overview and team culture, key responsibilities: [specific responsibilities] emphasizing B2B and B2C content creation, required qualifications highlighting minimum 5 years experience and portfolio requirements, preferred skills and experience that set candidates apart, growth opportunities and career development potential, competitive benefits or unique company perks, and clear application instructions. Use dynamic, action-oriented language that showcases the role’s impact and appeals to experienced content professionals.

prompts.name: Write a list of open-ended interview questions
prompts.body: I am a recruiter preparing interview questions for candidate screening based on the attached job description. Create 20 open-ended interview questions that assess: role-specific skills and experience mentioned in the job description, cultural fit and alignment with company values, problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, communication and interpersonal skills, motivation and career goals, leadership or teamwork capabilities, adaptability and learning agility, and situational judgment relevant to the position. Include a mix of behavioral (past experience), situational (hypothetical scenarios), and competency-based questions. Format with suggested follow-up questions and what strong responses should demonstrate

sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle: Sales processes, customer acquisition, pipeline management, and deal closure

prompts.name: Draft an email to sales leads about a customer issue
prompts.body: I am a [sales manager/regional director/customer success leader] communicating with Southeast region sales leads about a customer service issue requiring immediate action. Draft a professional email (150-200 words) that clearly explains the specific issues: [issues] affecting our customers, provides context about the impact and scope of the problem, instructs sales leads to immediately communicate with their teams about proactive customer outreach, includes talking points for customer conversations and apology messaging, authorizes offering 20% discount on future orders as service recovery, specifies any limitations or approval processes for the discount, requests confirmation of customer contact completion by specific deadline, and maintains a solution-focused tone that demonstrates accountability and customer commitment.

prompts.name: Draft an email to schedule an urgent meeting
prompts.body: I am a [sales manager/regional director/sales leader] calling an urgent meeting with regional sales representatives to address critical issues. Draft a professional email (100-150 words) that communicates the urgency and importance of meeting about [specific issues], requests availability for Monday or Tuesday of next week with specific time options, briefly explains why immediate discussion is necessary without causing alarm, asks for prompt response with their preferred time slots, indicates the meeting format (in-person/virtual) and expected duration, mentions who else will be attending, and uses a serious but supportive tone that emphasizes the need for swift action and team collaboration to resolve the situation.

prompts.name: Create convincing reasons for a customer to adopt a product
prompts.body: I am a [sales professional/account manager/solution consultant] developing a compelling value proposition for [customer name] to adopt [product name]. Using @[Product Sales Kit Full Assets], create persuasive reasons why our solution addresses their specific pain points: [pain points] and helps achieve their business goals: [business goals]. Include: direct problem-to-solution mapping with quantifiable benefits, competitive advantages that differentiate us from alternatives, ROI calculations or cost savings projections, implementation ease and timeline considerations, relevant case studies or success stories from similar customers, and risk mitigation factors. Structure as a consultative sales presentation that positions our product as the optimal solution for their unique situation.

prompts.name: List likely objections from a prospect and how to respond
prompts.body: I am a [sales representative/account executive/business development professional] in the [specific industry] preparing for a sales call with a prospect regarding [specific use case] for our [product]. This is a new use case for me, so I need comprehensive objection handling preparation. Generate 8-10 most likely objections [customer type] might raise including: pricing and budget concerns, competitive alternatives, implementation challenges, ROI justification, timing issues, and technical fit questions. For each objection, provide: proven response techniques and scripts, supporting evidence or data points to reference, questions to ask that reframe the conversation, ways to turn objections into selling opportunities, and follow-up strategies to maintain momentum. Format as a quick-reference guide for the call

prompts.name: Draft a customized script for a sales call
prompts.body: I am a [sales representative/account executive/business development manager] preparing for a 30-minute video sales call with a prospect in [customer’s industry]. Create a structured call script with timing estimates including: opening rapport-building and agenda setting (5 min), discovery questions to uncover pain points, tailored presentation of [company products/solutions] addressing their specific challenges (15 min), delivery system value proposition emphasizing seamless and timely service, competitive pricing structure with volume discount table, relevant customer reference story from [customer’s industry], objection handling preparation, closing techniques and next steps (5 min), and natural transition points for two-way dialogue. Format with speaker notes and key talking points for confident delivery.

prompts.name: Generate an elevator pitch for a product
prompts.body: I am a [sales professional/product manager/business development representative] developing a compelling elevator pitch for [product name] targeting [specific audience/industry]. Create a concise 60-90 second elevator pitch that includes: attention-grabbing hook addressing a clear pain point, key benefits and value propositions that [product name] delivers, 2-3 competitive differentiators that set us apart from alternatives, specific problems or challenges the product solves for customers, credibility elements (results, testimonials, or traction), and strong call-to-action for next steps. Structure for natural delivery with smooth transitions and memorable messaging that sparks further conversation.

groups.usecase: Nurture relationships, personalized outreach, and thought leadership

prompts.name: Draft an outreach email template to industry influencers
prompts.body: I am a [business development manager/marketing director/partnerships lead] following up with industry influencers after networking at [specific event name]. Draft a professional outreach email template (150-200 words) that references our connection at the event, expresses genuine appreciation for the conversation or insights they shared, proposes specific collaboration opportunities: [collaboration types – content partnerships/speaking engagements/co-marketing], outlines mutual value and benefits for both parties, includes relevant background on our company and why we’re a good fit, requests a brief call or meeting to discuss further, and maintains an authentic, relationship-focused tone rather than purely transactional approach.

prompts.name: Summarize blog content and generate follow-up questions
prompts.body: I am a [sales professional/account manager/customer success manager] using blog content to engage customers in meaningful conversations. Using the attached blog content, create a concise bullet-point summary of key insights and takeaways, then generate 3 thoughtful follow-up questions I can ask customers that: relate the blog’s themes to their business challenges or goals, encourage them to share their perspectives or experiences, demonstrate genuine interest in their industry knowledge, and create opportunities for deeper business discussions. Focus on open-ended questions that position me as a consultative partner rather than just a vendor

prompts.name: Create personalized onboarding materials for a new customer
prompts.body: I am a [customer success manager/onboarding specialist/account manager] creating customized onboarding materials for [customer name]. Using @[Standard Onboarding Documents] and @[New Customer Migration Notes], develop personalized onboarding assets including: welcome packet with customer-specific implementation timeline, customized setup guides reflecting their unique requirements, personalized training materials addressing their specific use cases, migration checklist tailored to their current systems, key contact information and escalation paths, success metrics and milestone tracking relevant to their goals, and next steps calendar with scheduled check-ins. Ensure all materials reflect their business context and specific needs identified during the sales process

prompts.name: Summarize emails from a specific person
prompts.body: You are an executive assistant and communications analyst. Analyze all emails from [SPECIFIC PERSON’S NAME] over the specified time period to understand their priorities, expectations, and relationship dynamics. Create a structured analysis with a table including Date, Subject Line, Key Message/Request, Action Items, Deadline/Timeline, and Priority Level. Look for communication patterns, satisfaction cues, escalating concerns, and commitments needing tracking. Format with headings: ‘Communication Overview & Patterns,’ ‘Detailed Email Summary Table,’ ‘Priority Analysis & Deadlines,’ ‘Relationship Health Assessment,’ and ‘Strategic Recommendations’ for proactive stakeholder management.

groups.usecase: Manage the request for proposal (RFP) process

prompts.name: Conduct research on a company that issued an RFP
prompts.body: I am a [sales professional/business development manager/proposal writer] preparing to respond to an RFP from [company name] and need comprehensive company intelligence. Research and create a detailed business profile including: company overview (headquarters location, founding date, size, ownership structure), core products/services and value proposition, target market segments and customer base, key leadership team and decision makers, recent financial performance or funding announcements, current strategic initiatives or business developments, recent news, press releases, or market activities, competitive positioning and industry reputation, and potential pain points or challenges they may be facing. Present findings in a structured format suitable for RFP strategy development

prompts.name: Summarize an RFP
prompts.body: I am a sales manager at [company name] analyzing an RFP received from [client company]. Using the attached [RFP document/URL], create a concise executive summary (3-4 paragraphs) covering: what the customer is seeking (specific products/services, scope of work, key requirements), project timeline and implementation expectations, budget parameters or spending authority mentioned, response deadline and submission requirements, evaluation criteria and decision-making process, key stakeholders involved, and any unique specifications or compliance requirements. Highlight critical elements that will impact our proposal strategy and competitive positioning.

groups.usecase: Improve collaboration and execution by customizing sales materials

prompts.name: Write a recap message to a customer after a meeting
prompts.body: I am a [sales representative/account manager/customer success manager] following up with [customer name] after our recent [meeting type – discovery call/product demo/consultation]. Using @[Customer Meeting Gemini Notes], write a professional follow-up message (150-200 words) that thanks them for their time and engagement, provides a concise summary of key discussion points and decisions made, acknowledges specific pain points or challenges they shared, demonstrates understanding of their business needs, proposes next steps to discuss how our [solution] addresses their requirements, and requests additional meeting time with suggested availability. Use a consultative tone that reinforces our value proposition

prompts.name: Summarize customer pain points from a call transcript
prompts.body: I am an account manager analyzing our recent customer call to identify key pain points and challenges. Using @[Customer Call Transcript], extract and summarize the specific pain points mentioned by [customer name] including: direct quotes where they describe problems they’re trying to solve, context around each challenge and its business impact, frequency or urgency indicators they mentioned, any current solutions they’ve tried unsuccessfully, and quantifiable impacts (time, cost, efficiency losses) they referenced. Organize findings by priority level and provide brief analysis of how each pain point relates to our solution capabilities.

prompts.name: Generate a personalized email for a customer’s one-month anniversary
prompts.body: I am a [customer success manager/account manager/sales representative] at [company name] sending a one-month anniversary email to [customer name]. Write a personalized email (150-200 words) that celebrates their one-month milestone as a valued customer, expresses genuine appreciation for their business and partnership, checks in on their experience and addresses any questions or concerns, introduces [other product] as a relevant solution that could enhance their results, includes a clear call-to-action for scheduling a check-in call or accessing additional resources, and maintains a warm, relationship-building tone that reinforces our commitment to their success.

prompts.name: Give me a list of gifts to send new clients
prompts.body: I am a [sales professional/account manager/business development representative] selecting client appreciation gifts for new partnerships. Generate a list of 10-12 professional gift options under $200 that can be shipped directly to corporate offices, including: branded and non-branded options, gifts suitable for different industries and company cultures, items that reflect quality and thoughtfulness, shipping-friendly products that arrive in good condition, gifts appropriate for various business relationships (small startups to large enterprises), estimated price ranges for budget planning, and brief rationale for each gift’s professional appeal and memorability.

prompts.name: Write an email inviting people to a happy hour
prompts.body: I am a [sales representative/business development manager/marketing coordinator] inviting prospects and clients to a networking happy hour at [trade show event]. Write a professional yet inviting email (100-150 words) that welcomes people interested in [focus area] to join us on [specific date and time] at [venue/location], highlights our expertise and specialization in [focus area], mentions what attendees can expect (networking, industry insights, casual conversation), includes RSVP instructions with contact information, and uses a warm, approachable tone that encourages attendance while positioning our company as a thought leader in the space.

prompts.name: Draft a follow-up email after a happy hour
prompts.body: I am a [sales representative/account manager/business development professional] following up with attendees from our happy hour networking event. Draft a warm, friendly thank-you email (100-125 words) that expresses genuine appreciation for their attendance at the happy hour on [specific date, time, location], briefly mentions highlights or positive moments from the event, reinforces our expertise in [relevant area] and value we discussed, invites continued conversation over the next few weeks, provides clear contact information and availability, and maintains the relaxed, personable tone from the networking event while opening doors for business discussions.

prompts.name: Write an introductory email to a new customer
prompts.body: I am a [account manager/sales representative/customer success manager] at [company name] writing a welcome email to [customer name], our new [title] contact at [client company]. Draft a professional introductory email (100-150 words) that congratulates them on their new role, introduces myself as their dedicated point of contact with brief overview of my support role, expresses enthusiasm about our partnership and commitment to their success, proposes an initial meeting (lunch or call) to discuss their priorities and how we can best serve their needs, offers specific scheduling options (Monday or Tuesday next week), and uses a warm, relationship-building tone that establishes trust while demonstrating our proactive customer service approach

prompts.name: Research a new customer’s market strategy
prompts.body: I am an [role-]  researching [customer name] as a new client. Analyze their current market strategy including: core business model and value proposition, target market segments and customer base, competitive positioning and key differentiators, recent strategic initiatives or market moves, growth objectives and expansion plans, and current market challenges or opportunities they’re addressing. Focus on insights that will help me understand their business priorities and identify ways our solutions can support their strategic goals. Present findings in a client briefing format.

groups.usecase: Coach and train the sales team

prompts.name: Create a half-day agenda for an educational session
prompts.body: Create a 4-hour educational session agenda for our sales team on [specific technology products]. Structure the agenda with: welcome/objectives (15 min), product development team presentation (60-90 min), hands-on demo or Q&A session (45 min), lunch break (60 min), sales strategy discussion (45 min), and wrap-up/next steps (15 min). Include specific learning objectives for each segment, suggested presenters or facilitators, and any materials or prep work needed. Ensure the agenda balances product education with practical sales application

prompts.name: Create a spreadsheet to track online courses
prompts.body: Create a spreadsheet template for tracking online sales training courses with these columns: Course Name, Main Topic/Category, Provider, Price, Duration (hours), Priority Level (High/Medium/Low), Completion Status, Start Date, Target Completion Date, and Notes. Include data validation for priority levels and status fields, conditional formatting to highlight overdue courses, and sample data for 5-10 relevant sales courses. Format as a professional template that’s easy to sort, filter, and update regularly

prompts.name: Compose a personalized follow-up email to a client
prompts.body: I am a [role – account manager/sales rep/consultant] composing a follow-up email to [client name] after our [meeting type – discovery call/presentation/consultation] on [date]. Draft a professional email (150-250 words) that recaps the 3-4 key discussion points, addresses any outstanding questions or concerns they raised, outlines agreed-upon next steps with specific timelines, and includes a clear call-to-action for our next interaction. Use a warm, professional tone and reference specific details from our conversation to demonstrate active listening.”

prompts.name: Draft weekly check-in email templates for a new customer
prompts.body: I am a [customer success manager/account manager] creating weekly check-in email templates for new [service] customers during their first month. Draft 4 email templates (100-150 words each) focusing on one value proposition per email: cost savings, ease of use, security, and availability. Each template should include: a personalized greeting, specific tips or insights related to that week’s focus area, a brief success story or example, and a clear [call to action]. Use a helpful, supportive tone that reinforces their purchase decision and encourages engagement with our platform.

prompts.name: Create an email draft explaining why your company is a good partner
prompts.body: I am a [sales/business development role] at [company name] writing to [prospect company] about a potential partnership. Draft a persuasive email (200-300 words) explaining why we’re the ideal partner to help them achieve [specific market goals – expansion, customer acquisition, etc.]. Include: our relevant expertise and track record, 2-3 specific capabilities that align with their objectives, quantifiable benefits or outcomes we can deliver, and a clear call-to-action for next steps. Use a professional yet personable tone and reference any mutual connections or previous interactions if applicable

prompts.name: Explain how a company can help a customer achieve their goals
prompts.body: Explain how [company name] can help [customer company] achieve their specific business goals of [list 2-3 key objectives]. Identify relevant products/services that address each goal, provide concrete examples of how these solutions would be implemented, and quantify potential benefits (cost savings, efficiency gains, revenue impact). Structure the response as a value proposition that connects our capabilities directly to their stated priorities and include 1-2 success stories or case studies from similar clients.

groups.usecase: Access information and tools on your phone while on the go

prompts.name: Write a response to an email acknowledging receipt and providing a timeline
prompts.body:
Write a professional email response with the following specifications:
Content Requirements:
Acknowledge receipt of [sender’s name]’s message regarding [specific topic/request]
Confirm commitment to [specific action to be taken] by [day of week, date]
Include 2-3 sentences maximum for conciseness
Maintain a professional yet approachable tone
Format Requirements:
Include proper email greeting addressing [sender’s name]
Add appropriate professional closing with signature line
Use standard business email structure
Tone Guidelines:
Professional but warm
Confident and reassuring
Clear and direct communication
Output Format:
Provide the complete email ready to send, with clear placeholders in brackets [ ] for customization.

software-development.title: Software Development
software-development.subtitle: Software development, coding, technical documentation, and programming tasks

prompts.name: Generate HTML and CSS code for a responsive navigation bar
prompts.body: I am a [web developer/frontend developer/designer] creating a responsive navigation bar. Generate clean, semantic HTML and CSS code with these specifications: color scheme using [specific colors/hex codes], logo integration from [logo file/URL], menu items: [specific menu items list], mobile-first responsive design with hamburger menu for smaller screens, smooth transitions and hover effects, accessibility features (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation), and cross-browser compatibility. Include CSS flexbox or grid for layout, media queries for breakpoints, and commented code explaining key sections. Ensure the navbar is ready for integration into existing projects.

startup-leaders.title: Startup leaders
startup-leaders.subtitle: Startup strategy, business development, product launch, and entrepreneurial planning

prompts.name: Create a press release with a catchy title
prompts.body: You are a PR specialist. Create a professional press release with a compelling headline (under 10 words), strong lead paragraph answering who/what/when/where/why in 50 words, strategic quotes from @[VIP Quotes Acquisition], supporting data/metrics, and proper journalistic structure. Use active voice, specific details, and maintain professional yet engaging tone. Format with headings: ‘Press Release,’ ‘Alternative Headlines,’ ‘Distribution Strategy,’ ‘Target Media List,’ and ‘Social Media Adaptations

prompts.name: Identify trends and patterns in expenses
prompts.body: I am a [startup founder/CFO/financial analyst] analyzing our company’s expense patterns for strategic planning. Using the attached expense spreadsheet, conduct a comprehensive analysis of spending trends over the last three years including: expense category breakdown with year-over-year growth rates, identification of categories with significant cost increases (>15-20% annually), seasonal or cyclical patterns in spending, correlation between expense growth and business milestones or revenue, potential cost drivers (headcount growth, market expansion, technology investments), benchmarking against typical startup expense ratios, and actionable recommendations for cost optimization or budget reallocation. Present findings with data visualizations and executive summary suitable for board presentation.

prompts.name: Help me grow my personal brand
prompts.body: I am the founder of [startup name] in [specific industry] building my personal brand to generate media coverage and business growth. I’m passionate about [specific topics] and want to inspire [target audience] with entrepreneurial insights and startup lessons. Develop a personal branding strategy including: content pillars and messaging themes that showcase expertise, optimal social media platforms and posting strategies for my audience, thought leadership opportunities (speaking, writing, podcasting), networking and partnership approaches, content formats that resonate (stories, tips, case studies), and measurable goals with timeline for building following and media attention. Focus on authentic, value-driven approaches that establish credibility in my industry.

prompts.name: Clean a user feedback survey spreadsheet
prompts.body: I need to clean my user feedback survey spreadsheet with these specific transformations: replace all blank values in the ‘Name’ column with ‘Anonymous’, change ‘Yes’ to ‘Y’ in the ‘Recommend’ column, and remove any rows where the ‘Satisfaction’ column is blank. Process the attached spreadsheet file and generate a new cleaned version with these changes applied. Maintain all other data and column formatting, and provide a summary of how many rows were modified or removed during the cleaning process.

prompts.name: Build a high-level roadmap
prompts.body: I am head of product at [startup name] in the [specific industry] developing a Q4 delivery roadmap for [product name]. Based on recurring user feedback including [specific feedback trends], create a high-level roadmap table for implementing [specific features] with columns for: Feature/Initiative, Priority Level (P0/P1/P2), Quarter/Month Timeline, Key Milestones, Dependencies, Resource Requirements, and Success Metrics. Structure the roadmap to ensure Q4 delivery while addressing the most critical user feedback first. Include buffer time for testing and iteration, and highlight any potential risks or blockers.

prompts.name: Craft a synopsis of a product launch
prompts.body: Please craft a concise and impactful synopsis of the product launch using information from @[Product Launch – Notes], structured around three key points: (1) the product’s core value proposition or innovative feature set and how it solves a meaningful problem; (2) the target audience or market segment it is intended to serve, including why this group benefits most from the launch; and (3) the broader strategic significance of the product for the company, such as competitive differentiation, market expansion, or alignment with long-term business goals; ensure the tone is clear, compelling, and adaptable for internal stakeholders, media briefings, or promotional use, and that the structure allows for easy repurposing across multiple communication channels.

prompts.name: Create a slide describing a product
prompts.body: Please create a clear and visually engaging slide that describes what [product] is, using information from @[Product Launch – Notes], including: a concise product definition or positioning statement that is easily understood by a broad, non-technical audience; 3–4 bullet points highlighting the product’s key features or benefits; optional visual elements such as icons or diagrams to support comprehension; and a short tagline or headline that captures the essence of the product in a compelling way; ensure the tone is informative but accessible, the layout is clean and presentation-ready, and the content is appropriate for both internal stakeholders and external partners or media.

prompts.name: Brainstorm different scenarios for a product launch plan
prompts.body: I am head of product at [startup name] in the [specific industry] preparing to launch [product name/description]. Analyze 4 launch scenarios combining pricing options [price point A vs. price point B] with timing options [December vs. January launch]. For each scenario, provide: market conditions and competitive landscape considerations, customer readiness and demand factors, pros and cons with potential risks and opportunities, resource requirements and operational impact, and expected outcomes for user acquisition and revenue. Additionally, suggest 3-4 alternative approaches we may not have considered, such as different pricing models, phased rollouts, or market entry strategies.

prompts.name: Compare product prices to competitors
prompts.body: I am a [product manager/pricing strategist/startup founder] analyzing competitive pricing for [our product category]. Research and compare pricing strategies of [specific competitor products] including: current pricing tiers and structures, promotional tactics (free trials, discounts, bundles), value-based positioning and messaging to [target audience], pricing psychology and anchoring strategies, and any recent pricing changes or market moves. Provide a structured comparison showing how our pricing [current/proposed prices] positions against competitors, identify pricing gaps or opportunities, and cite all sources used for the analysis. Focus on actionable insights for our pricing strategy.

groups.usecase: Create an elevator pitch (speech to text)

prompts.name: Create a short elevator pitch for a startup
prompts.body: I am the founder of [startup name] in the [specific industry] creating an elevator pitch for [specific audience – investors/customers/partners]. Develop a compelling 60-90 second pitch that includes: attention-grabbing hook that addresses a clear problem, solution overview highlighting [key product features], market opportunity and traction metrics, competitive advantage or unique value proposition, clear ask for [specific action], and anticipation of 2-3 likely follow-up questions with prepared responses. Use a professional yet conversational tone that demonstrates confidence while building credibility and urgency

prompts.name: Draft a personalized email template to potential investors
prompts.body: I am a [founder/CEO/VP of Business Development] at [company name] reaching out to potential investors. Draft a personalized email template (200-250 words) that introduces our company and unique value proposition in [industry/market], highlights recent progress and key milestones on [specific initiatives], includes relevant traction metrics or achievements, demonstrates market opportunity and growth potential, and requests a meeting within the next month to discuss investment opportunities. Use a professional yet compelling tone with clear personalization placeholders for investor name, firm, and relevant background research.

prompts.name: Draft a thank you email to a potential investor
prompts.body: I am a [founder/CEO/business development executive] following up with a potential investor after our initial call. Draft a professional thank you email (100-150 words) that expresses appreciation for their time and interest, briefly recaps key discussion points from our conversation, acknowledges their specific [questions and concerns] and confirms we’ll address them comprehensively, proposes a follow-up meeting with suggested timeframes, and reinforces our enthusiasm about potential partnership. Use a confident yet respectful tone that maintains momentum from the initial conversation

prompts.name: Create a comparison table for vendor proposals
prompts.body: I need to evaluate two packaging manufacturing vendor proposals from @[Company A’s Proposal] and @[Company B’s Proposal]. Create a comprehensive comparison table with key evaluation criteria: pricing (unit cost, setup fees, volume discounts), production capabilities (capacity, lead times, minimum orders), quality standards (certifications, materials, testing), service factors (customer support, delivery reliability, customization options), and contract terms (payment terms, warranties, flexibility). Include a scoring system (1-5 scale) for each criterion and calculate weighted totals to support decision-making. Format as a clear, printable comparison chart

prompts.name: Create an email draft to negotiate a bulk pricing discount
prompts.body: I am a [role – procurement manager/operations director] drafting an email to [selected vendor] confirming our decision to partner with them for [packaging services] while requesting a bulk pricing discount. Write a collaborative email (150-200 words) that expresses enthusiasm about the partnership, references specific strengths that led to our selection, presents our volume projections and bulk discount request with clear business rationale, and proposes next steps for finalizing terms. Use a professional yet friendly tone that positions this as a mutually beneficial discussion rather than a demand.

prompts.name: Turn whiteboard notes into text
prompts.body: I am a founder at a [industry] startup and need to convert brainstorming whiteboard notes about [specific topic/challenge] into organized text. Transcribe all visible text from the attached whiteboard image and structure the content into: main themes or categories, key ideas under each theme, action items or next steps, and any questions or unresolved points. Present the information in a clear, scannable format with bullet points or numbered lists, and flag any text that’s unclear or illegible for confirmation

prompts.name: Suggest follow-up items for a brainstorm session
prompts.body: Based on our brainstorming session about [specific topic/challenge], identify 5-7 potential follow-up discussion items we may have overlooked. Analyze gaps in these areas: implementation challenges, resource requirements, timeline considerations, stakeholder impact, risk factors, and success metrics. For each suggested follow-up item, provide a brief rationale for why it’s important and indicate if it’s a critical gap or nice-to-have discussion. Focus on actionable next steps that could strengthen our original brainstorming outcomes.

strategy-business-planning.title: Strategy & Business Planning
strategy-business-planning.subtitle: Strategic planning, business analysis, process improvement, and operational strategy

prompts.name: Write a comprehensive business plan
prompts.body: I am a [business owner/entrepreneur/strategic planner] developing a comprehensive business plan for [company name] in the [specific industry] targeting [detailed target market]. Create a professional business plan including: executive summary with company overview and value proposition, market analysis and competitive landscape assessment, detailed description of products/services: [list of products/services], marketing and sales strategy with customer acquisition plans, operational plan and organizational structure, management team and key personnel, financial projections: [specific financial projections] with 3-5 year forecasts, funding requirements and use of capital, risk analysis and mitigation strategies, and implementation timeline with key milestones. Format as a comprehensive document suitable for investors, lenders, or strategic planning purposes

prompts.name: Generate a detailed market research report
prompts.body: I am a [business analyst/marketing manager/strategic planner] conducting comprehensive market research for the [specific industry] targeting [detailed target audience demographics/psychographics]. Create a detailed market research report analyzing competitors: [list of competitors] and including: industry overview with size, growth trends, and key drivers, target audience analysis with buying behaviors and preferences, competitive landscape with positioning, pricing, and market share, market opportunities and gaps, regulatory or technological factors impacting the industry, customer pain points and unmet needs, and strategic recommendations for market entry or expansion. Present with executive summary, data visualizations, and actionable insights.

prompts.name: Generate a 5-year financial projection for a new coffee shop
prompts.body: I am a [entrepreneur/business owner/financial planner] developing financial projections for a new coffee shop venture. Create a comprehensive 5-year financial model including: startup costs breakdown: [specific startup costs], projected revenue by stream: [revenue streams] with growth assumptions, annual operating expenses: [operating expenses] with inflation factors, monthly cash flow projections for Year 1, annual P&L statements for Years 1-5, break-even analysis and timeline, key financial ratios and performance metrics, and sensitivity analysis for different scenarios. Present in spreadsheet format with clear assumptions documented for each projection.
